utme_subjects: and any other two (2) subjects from Arts and Social Sciences
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes including French and English Language plus one other Arts subject.
direct_entry: Two (2) `A' Level passes including French and one other Arts subject.

institution_waivers.note: Accepts a) NCE merit in French and one other Arts subject. b) NCE Double major in French.

Accepts a) Candidates with two (2) `A' Level passes in Arts into the 4-year programme. b) Two (2) `A' Level passes including French at IJMB/NCE. General English/Use of English at NCE satisfies UTME English Language requirement.
Accepts NCE in French and any French Baccalaureate `A' Level.
Accepts two (2) NCE passes to include French and one other Arts subject.

Accepts a) Five (5) `O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, plus two (2) `A' Level passes one of which must be in French. b) Four (4) `O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, plus three (3) `A' Level passes one of which must be in French. c) Five (5) `O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, plus two (2) NCE merit or credit passes of which one must be in French.

a) Candidate must have at least a merit pass in French and one other Art subject at the NCE level. b) GCE A/L passes should include French and one other Arts subject. c) Certified Diploma in French from a recognized Institute like the Nigerian French Language Village and the likes will be accepted in place of A level French.
Accepts NCE merit including French and one other subject from Arts and Social Science subject. Ibadan accepts candidates without `O' level in French.
Accepts at least two A level passes including french and one other Arts or Social science subjects. This is applicable for NCE, OND, IJMB, JUPEB, and GCE A level.
Accepts ND, NCE with French as principal subject. Requires three (3) `A' Level passes in relevant subjects.

Accepts Very good passes in JUPEB/A' Level subjects: French and any two of Igbo/Yoruba, CRS/IRS, History, Government, Literature-in-English, Music and Fine Arts. NCE in French/NFLV, Diploma/Diplôme Supérieur (MODULE III), DALF (France), CEGEP (Canada), Baccalaureate, CAP and BTS.
Accepts NCE merit pass in French (Nigeria French Language Village) and the likes.
